# Inside Out Emotion Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, unofficial Inside Out emotion quiz in chat, just for fun. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, and names the emotion that fits your answers best, with a short explanation. It is not a personality test, and it is not a health tool.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Disney or Pixar. No official text, image, or quiz is copied here. Just for fun, not a real personality test, and not a health tool. Never a diagnosis, never medical advice, never talking to Riley.
